newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CRA wants shorter title process.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CRA wants shorter title process.

text.p: Global mining group RTZ-CRA called on Tuesday for a speedier process for resolving disputes over claims for indigenous land title in Australia.

Leigh Clifford, the managing director of CRA, the Australian arm of the Anglo-Australian mining group, made the call after talks failed last Friday to resolve a dispute with Aborigines over the development of a major zinc deposit in the country's northeast by Century Zinc Ltd, a unit of RTZ-CRA.
The dispute, which involves claims by local Aborigines for native land title to the mine site, is due now to be resolved by arbitration after protracted talks failed to reach a solution.
"The process is too drawn out and it takes too long," Clifford told a business luncheon in Melbourne.
"If agreement can't be reached, we need a very rapid determination process and there's no reason why that claim process can't be concertinaed into less than six months."
